class.name: SlugFont
class.brief_description: GPU font data for rendering resolution-independent text with the Slug algorithm.
class.description: SlugFont holds the data [SlugLabel3D] needs to draw text directly from Bézier glyph outlines on the GPU, following Eric Lengyel's Slug algorithm. Unlike a rasterized [DynamicFont], a Slug glyph has no fixed resolution: the same font data stays sharp at any distance or angle, which makes it a good fit for large or close-up world-space text such as signs. SlugFont is built from a [member font_data] [DynamicFontData]. Both quadratic (TrueType) and cubic (CFF/OTF) outlines are supported: cubic curves are split into quadratics adaptively when the font is built. The charset covers ASCII, Latin-1, and the replacement character U+FFFD. The font is not built eagerly: the curve, band, and glyph textures are generated lazily, in a few milliseconds, the first time a [SlugLabel3D] needs them. SlugFont only works with the GLES3 rendering backend.

method.name: get_build_time_usec
method.description: Returns how long the last build of this font's GPU data took, in microseconds. Triggers the build if it hasn't happened yet.

method.name: get_glyph_count
method.description: Returns the number of glyphs baked into this font's data. Triggers the build if it hasn't happened yet.

method.name: get_max_curves_per_band
method.description: Returns the largest number of curves found in any single band of any glyph, a measure of the worst-case per-pixel cost when rasterizing this font. Triggers the build if it hasn't happened yet.

method.name: is_valid
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if [member font_data] is set and was built successfully. Returns [code]false[/code] if [member font_data] is empty, or if the source font has cubic (CFF/OTF) outlines, which Slug does not support.

members.member: The TrueType font file this SlugFont's GPU data is built from. Must have quadratic outlines; CFF/OTF fonts with cubic outlines make the font invalid.
